Title: PNY Unveils the NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 50-Series GPU Family
URL: https://www.pny.com/company/press-center/pny-press-releases/nvidia-geforce-rtx-50-series
Published: 2025-01-06T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Parsippany, New Jersey, January 6, 2025 - PNY announced today the arrival of the GeForce RTX™ 5090, RTX 5080, RTX 5070 Ti, and RTX 5070 graphics cards to its lineup of NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs.

...

The PNY GeForce RTX 50 Series Overclocked line of GPUs will be available in four different configurations: GeForce RTX 5090, RTX 5080, RTX 5070 Ti, and RTX 5070, all powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, providing enhanced gaming realism, powerful real time ray tracing, and cutting-edge features to accelerate gaming performance. These PNY GPUs, which include on-board memory of 32GB, 16GB or 12GB GDDR7, are factory-overclocked for optimal performance. Tap into unprecedented power to break through performance barriers and effortlessly power through graphics demands at all resolutions.

## Dynamic Design

PNY's lineup of graphics cards now features the latest GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs. These graphics cards are available with either triple-fan, VGA support kits, and EPIC-X RGB™ lighting. Each card's unique cooling technology delivers high-performance cooling, even during demanding gaming and content production sessions.

With three fans working in tandem, heat is more effectively distributed and dissipated across the GPU surface. Additionally, PNY's Metal Backplate provides extra support to prevent sagging, while specially designed vents enhance passive cooling. 

Using VelocityX™ Software, users can take full control over their PNY graphics card to optimize its performance and ARGB lighting if they have a compatible PNY ARGB Lighting-enabled GPU.

...

## Overclocking and ARGB Customization

The PNY GeForce RTX 5090, RTX 5080, RTX 5070 Ti, and RTX 5070 GPUs feature one model per range with EPIC-X RGB lighting. With infinite ARGB lighting options, users can enjoy a fully customized lighting experience. Showcase creativity and personalize your lighting display using PNY's VelocityX™ control software, which also allows monitoring of key statistics such as core clock, memory clock, core temperature, fan speed, RGB lighting, and more.

## Build Small. Play Big.

The PNY GeForce RTX 5070 ARGB OC VERTO and RTX 5070 STD OC VERTO meet the SFF-Ready Enthusiast GeForce Card sizing guideline. When paired with a compatible mITX or mATX case, the parts are a sure fit when building a high-performance system to fit in a small footprint.

...
